_comment: The owner's grades for the FRESH set (seed 91500, f_human/, 31 sprites),
which neither judge had seen at grading time. Recorded from the DSH question
buttons, by sheet label, then converted to stems via grade_sheet_map.json so
scoring never depends on positional numbering.
'accept' lists every variant the owner would ship; an empty list means all
were unusable. Some props have two acceptable variants, so a judge is
scored on landing inside the set, not on reproducing a single 'best'.

cart.note: 1 and 3, both ok but not great

hay_bale.note: all look like boxes, not hay bales

well.note: 3 but it does not look great
